issue.title: docs-check generated glossary omits the item-start dot route alias
issue.description: On clean master 2f14eef5, just docs-check passes lint then fails generated drift solely for docs/reference/glossary.md. The generator diff contains only the Capture Alias dot-to-route bullet: the committed page lacks the item-start dot form added by 9b8ab39c. Regenerate the page with the canonical docs tooling and verify just docs-check. Both proposing phases reported the same issue on their clean bases. Same-type and all-task searches plus the 68-task last-week sweep found no semantic duplicate: b6 tracks the already-resolved decisions page, not this glossary node. Reviewed all 14 active epic scopes; this standalone dot-route documentation change belongs to none of them. No memory behavior change is needed.
